card.name: Misuse in abuse and addiction warnings
card.fires_on: The ending of the word misuse ("use" after "Mis", or "misuse" itself) in boxed warning headings like "Abuse, Misuse, and Addiction" and in controlled-substance abuse sections.

modes.label: Boxed warning heading
modes.description: The "USE" or "use" ending of "MISUSE" in the heading "Abuse, Misuse, and Addiction" before a stimulant drug name.
modes.example: WARNING: ABUSE, MIS<<USE>>, AND ADDICTION Dextro

modes.label: Abuse and misuse section
modes.description: The "use" or "used" ending of misuse in section titles or sentences about abuse potential.
modes.example: Abuse and Misuse SPRAVATO has the potential to be abused and mis<<used>>.

card.plain: It lights up on the last part of "misuse" in the standard abuse and addiction warning headings.
